 Dengue claims 8 more lives, 1,674 hospitalised in 24 hours
 The Report Desk 
 Published: November 14, 2026, 11:05 PM 
 -->
 -->
 Photo/collected
 Eight more people have died from dengue and 1,674 new patients have been admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh in the 24 hours to Saturday morning, raising the death toll from the mosquito-borne disease to 491 this year.
 According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), six of the latest deaths were reported in Dhaka division, while Chattogram and Rajshahi divisions recorded one death each.
 Since January 1, a total of 160,557 people have been hospitalised with dengue across the country.
 Of them, 154,151 patients have recovered, the DGHS data showed.
